subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "If identifier-1 references a function and the FILE phrase is not specified, identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function." FromPhraseRules.Rewrite carries the WIDER admitted set (alphanumeric, boolean, national) -> COBOL1914 otherwise. Probe pk.cob: `FROM FUNCTION INTEGER(2.5)` -> error COBOL1914 citing 14.9.35.3 SR9; `FROM FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("ab")` accepted; pj.cob `REWRITE R1 FROM FUNCTION BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER(5, 8)` into a boolean record compiles clean (the boolean half REWRITE admits and WRITE/RELEASE do not). The negative fixture pins the rejection half at all four editions; the boolean-admitted half has no positive fixture. cite.py --check 14.9.35.3 SR9 -> OK. [editions as adjudicated: 2023; ISO 1989:2023 Annex E lists no 2014->2023 change to this rule (E.3.3 item 41 touches GR10 only), so 2014 identically; the 1985/2002 wording is not derivable from the 2023 text]
